rule: Exceptions must be exact, evidence-backed, and limited to immutable/append-only legacy integrity defects.

exceptions.reason: The change-log block was duplicated before executable integrity-gate adoption. The two blocks are semantically identical; append-only governance forbids deleting or rewriting the historical entry solely to make the scanner green.
exceptions.disposition: Treat the first occurrence as the canonical log event and the later identical occurrence as a registered legacy duplicate for identity-uniqueness checking only. Do not create any new record with this Change ID.
